An attacker can execute arbitrary OS commands on the server via the `mitre_lab_17_api` endpoint by injecting shell metacharacters into the `ip` parameter. 1. Attacker sends a POST request to `/mitre_lab_17_api` with `ip` set to `127.0.0.1; cat /etc/passwd > /tmp/pwned`.

3. `command_out(command)` (line 14–16) invokes `subprocess.Popen(command, shell=True, …)`, causing the shell to execute `nmap 127.0.0.1`, then `cat /etc/passwd > /tmp/pwned`.

    if isinstance(command, str):

    process = subprocess.Popen(command, shell=False, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    return process.communicate()
```

```
